test_apply_policies: test the apply_policies function to run guardrails from policy names and guardrail names on inputs
test_test_policies_and_guardrails: test the test_policies_and_guardrails endpoint to apply policies and guardrails to request or response inputs
test_validate_policy: test the validate_policy endpoint to validate a policy configuration before applying it
test_list_policies: test the list_policies endpoint to list all loaded policies with their resolved guardrails
test_get_policy_info: test the get_policy_info endpoint to get detailed information about a specific policy
test_test_policy_matching: test the test_policy_matching endpoint to test which policies match a given request context
test_get_policy_templates: test the get_policy_templates endpoint to get pre-configured guardrail combinations from GitHub or local backup
test_enrich_policy_template: test the enrich_policy_template endpoint to enrich a policy template with LLM-discovered competitor names
test_enrich_policy_template_stream: test the enrich_policy_template_stream endpoint to stream competitor names as SSE events
test_suggest_policy_templates: test the suggest_policy_templates endpoint to use AI to suggest policy templates based on attack examples
test_test_policy_template: test the test_policy_template endpoint to test guardrail definitions against a text input
build_apply_policies: build a function that applies guardrails from policy names and guardrail names to request or response inputs
build_validate_policy: build a function that validates a policy configuration checking guardrails exist, inheritance chains, and scope patterns
build_enrich_policy_template: build a function that enriches a policy template with LLM-discovered competitor names and generates guardrail definitions
build_test_policy_template: build a function that tests guardrail definitions against text input and returns per-guardrail pass or block results
